# Debug render

Query target: `DEBUG_RENDER`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

## Conditions

### Debug

Instance-level target, available without a stage. Scope uses dictionary-owned path tokens; settings persist, geometry is read-only. Scope and cullingBox have asymmetric read/write encodings.
